curated-gf-playwrite-cl-guides-gf-pt-mon: Graceful handwriting leads, with Playwrite CL Guides keeping its lowercase low. PT Mono, a monospace, spaces every letter apart, so running paragraphs would feel measured, better kept to brief copy.
curated-gf-playwrite-co-gf-noto-sans-lim: Wiry, friendly handwriting is what Playwrite CO brings. Noto Sans Limbu, a sans-serif with tall-bodied small letters, looks best given a modest size next to that low, wire-bent heading.
curated-gf-playwrite-co-gf-roboto-flex: Loose pen-on-paper charm comes from Playwrite CO, friendly and casual. Roboto Flex, a sans-serif with a wide slot in its c, is best sized modestly for brief bits of text.
curated-gf-playwrite-cz-guides-fs-recia: Playwrite CZ Guides gives a relaxed, widely tracked hand-drawn look, with a lowercase that shrinks well beneath its caps. Recia holds an authoritative tone over paragraphs, though brief copy suits it best.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-sas-gf-gilda-dis: Gilda Display brings dramatic contrast, hairline tops over fat sides, beneath the casual strokes of Playwrite DE SAS. Gilda Display keeps a traditional, bookish voice across a few lines, say in a pet memorial book.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-sas-guides-gf-ca: Unvarying line thickness defines Playwrite DE SAS Guides (think embroidered patch lettering). Carme, the sans, adds open modern counters below, so the handwriting leads and the text stays quiet in modest amounts.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-va-baskervville: Friendly, hand-drawn curves from Playwrite DE VA, small and round on tall stems. Baskervville brings hairline crossbars and a low-set lowercase, reading with dignity but tiring over lengthy paragraphs.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-va-guides-gf-im-: Playwrite DE VA Guides writes in a relaxed, single-weight, casual hand. It handles casual warmth, while IM Fell French Canon, a serif, brings bookish detail that suits modest portions, as in a gratitude journal.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-va-guides-gf-pla: Playwrite DE VA Guides is relaxed, with casual single-weight letters. The standout is Playfair, whose pale threads between heavy stems lift the casual heading, though lengthy paragraphs are not its job.
curated-gf-playwrite-dk-loopet-guides-gf: Tall capitals tower over a tiny lowercase in Playwrite DK Loopet Guides (a children's picture book title, say). Gentium Plus, a serif, keeps paragraphs refined and gentle in modest portions.
